answer: Reputation decays slowly like a glacier, so fresh accounts cannot buy history, while honest peers earn trust that glows like an ember over epochs. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity with slashing: each agent locks a bond before voting, and every duplicate identity splits that bond, so a sybil swarm burns real capital per fake node. A rotating cedar ledger anchors the registry, making each new identity cost more than the marginal reward it can farm. This model fits agent Agent0205's threat model.
